title: A handy travel guide to Gartner Data & Analytics Summit 2027
body_markdown:
Gartner Data & Analytics Summit 2027 runs March 8–10 at Gaylord Palms Resort & Convention Center in Kissimmee, Florida.\[1\]


This guide covers helpful travel choices for anyone attending or considering the summit — where to stay, how to reach the resort, how to plan a budget and how to organize a productive trip that helps connect the ideas you’ll learn to your own organization.


### Key takeaways


- Gaylord Palms in Kissimmee is the summit venue. Compare hotel costs together with airport transfers and the daily trip to the resort.\[2\]
- [Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) can book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations in one chat, with support available 24/7\[8\]
- Connecting your airline and hotel loyalty programs helps Navan Edge personalize recommendations and show what you can earn on each stay.\[8\]
- Plan sessions and conversations around a data or AI decision your team needs to make. Gartner’s current session listings look back at 2026 while the full 2027 agenda is being developed.\[3\]


## What is Gartner Data & Analytics Summit and who should attend?


Gartner Data & Analytics Summit is a three-day event for people leading or supporting data, analytics, and AI programs, and it’s aimed at chief data and analytics officers, heads of AI, and data and analytics leaders.\[1\] The 2027 program is especially relevant if you are responsible for turning data or AI investment into decisions about priorities, governance, architecture, or business outcomes.


## What makes the summit worth attending?


Gartner's 2027 tracks are set to address leading data and AI organizations, scaling AI and analytics, and connecting investment to business value.\[3\] The best way to approach it is with a decision your team is actually facing such as prioritizing data work, changing governance responsibilities or deciding what an AI initiative needs before it can expand.


Bringing your own specific constraints and questions to analyst and peer conversations will allow you the opportunity to explain who uses the data, where your work is stuck and what you have already tried. Hopefully then the guidance you get will be more useful.


If you’re attending as a team, you can cover even more ground. One person can investigate the operating model while another examines architecture or delivery.


## Where to stay for Gartner Data & Analytics Summit


The venue address is 6000 W. Osceola Parkway, Kissimmee, Florida 34746. Gartner holds a limited allocation of discounted rooms for registered attendees, subject to availability.\[2\]


An onsite stay may be useful if you have early appointments or would like to return to your room between sessions. If you’re considering an offsite option, check the full room price, shuttle timetable and any rides required outside service hours.

## Flights and transfers to Gaylord Palms


When comparing flights to Orlando International Airport (MCO), allow time to collect your bags, reach your hotel, and check in.


If you have a Monday morning session or meeting, consider arriving Sunday so you have time to settle in. If you do fly in Monday, leave enough time between landing and your first commitment.


Taxis are available at Terminal A on Level 1, spaces A22–A25; Terminal B on Level 1, spaces B30–B34; and Terminal C on Level 6. Fares are metered.\[4\]

## How to set a travel budget for the summit


Build your budget around the full trip, including:


- **Registration:** Your conference pass and any paid optional activities.
- **Flights:** Airfare and any baggage or seat-selection fees.
- **Hotel:** The number of nights, room rate, taxes, and mandatory fees.
- **Transport:** Airport transfers and daily travel to Gaylord Palms, including rides outside shuttle hours.
- **Meals:** Food not included in your registration and any meals you plan to host.


Compare hotel and transport costs together. A cheaper room may cost more overall if you need a car ride to and from the summit each day.


If your employer uses federal per diem, check the rate for Kissimmee and your March 2027 travel dates. GSA generally bases the applicable locality on where you work, rather than where you stay.\[5\]


## What to pack for the summit


March climate averages in Orlando are about 79°F during the day and 56°F at night, with roughly three inches of rain over the month.\[6\] You can use these as a packing guide, but it’s recommended to check the forecast closer to departure.


Pack for time outside as well as inside the conference rooms:


- Comfortable shoes for the resort and conference spaces
- Clothing suited to business meetings, with an extra option for a more formal event
- A compact umbrella or light rain shell.
- Device chargers, portable battery and your registration information.
- A short, shareable brief for analyst, peer or supplier conversations.


## Where to eat during Gartner Data & Analytics Summit 2027


A meal at Gaylord Palms can be a great opportunity to catch up with colleagues and new connections. Here are some recommendations in the resort:


- **Old Hickory Steakhouse** : An option for a planned business dinner. It lists a smart-casual dress code.\[7\]
- **Wreckers Sports Bar** : A casual option for lunch or dinner, with sports screens. Check the noise level if you want to discuss work in detail.\[7\]
- **Villa de Flora:** A Mediterranean restaurant that serves breakfast. Check opening times against your first session.\[7\]


You can ask Navan Edge to find and book a restaurant reservation based on your specific preferences, whether that’s a lively group dinner, a quiet business lunch, or even a solo bite on the go.


## Wrapping up and returning home


Before booking your flight home, check when your final session or meeting ends on Wednesday, March 10.\[1\] Allow time to collect your bags, travel to MCO, and meet your airline’s airport-arrival guidance.


Before leaving, organize any notes and be clear on the ideas you want to relay to your team. Separate actions you can take now from proposals that need more research or approval, and give each next step an owner and a date. Arrange a short team debrief while the sessions and conversations are still fresh.
